title: Expected weight and recovery study
credit: Rain Rig (CC) Blender Foundation | studio.blender.org | CC BY 4.0

geometry.scope: Weighted forearms/hands against torso and shirt; all case parts against body/shirt; supports and native timeline. Hair, finger self-contact and artistic quality require visual review.

export.scope: Encoding and frame correspondence only; sheets require separate visual review. No audio.

visual_review: Entire sequence sampled every 6 frames; lift/recovery every 2 frames; key pose seen front and side in separate Blender window. Not continuous real-time viewing.
limits: Restricted study of contact, expected weight and recovery; general facial expression and weak concealment of embarrassment. No audio, full dynamics, finger self-contact or universal acting claim.
